consequences.delta: size_hint removed; split into optimization_hint (may be non-concrete) and guarding_hint_or_throw (concrete or exception).
consequences.impact: SDSC concretization would silently accept non-concrete values, producing wrong compilation.
consequences.fix: Use guarding_hint_or_throw at final concretization points (superdsc.py:602).
consequences.discovery: review by dgrove-oss reading the docstring for _concretize_for_sdsc; initial patch used the wrong replacement.

consequences.surface: torch._inductor.decomposition (mm/bmm K==1 case, arange, tril, triu, isin, index_copy.out)
consequences.impact: Fallback registration on ops that now have in-tree decompositions hits an assertion in make_fallback().
consequences.fix: register_fallback_over_decomp() helper + spyre_decompositions_to_exclude entries for K==1 mm/bmm.
consequences.upstream_followup: bohnstingl landed pytorch/pytorch#185909 to fix decomposition handling; awaiting 2.12.1 GA to make effective.

consequences.delta: Dynamo now graph-breaks when Python wrapper calls C++ orig_to.
consequences.impact: D2D dtype casts (fp16<->bf16) went eager and returned wrong results.
consequences.fix: torch._dynamo.allow_in_graph(torch.Tensor.to) — global side effect, defended as acceptable.
consequences.discovery: wrong-dtype output; not surfaced by an exception.

consequences.fix: Coordinated with #1856 (Move aiupti changes from kineto plugin).
